### <a name="k3s"></a>`k3s`

Install and manage k3s on Linux hosts.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `k3s` class:

* [`mode`](#-k3s--mode)
* [`ensure`](#-k3s--ensure)
* [`channel`](#-k3s--channel)

* [`token`](#-k3s--token)
* [`server`](#-k3s--server)
* [`cluster_init`](#-k3s--cluster_init)
* [`write_kubeconfig_mode`](#-k3s--write_kubeconfig_mode)
* [`node_name`](#-k3s--node_name)
* [`node_labels`](#-k3s--node_labels)
* [`node_taints`](#-k3s--node_taints)

* [`flannel_backend`](#-k3s--flannel_backend)
* [`selinux`](#-k3s--selinux)

* [`service_ensure`](#-k3s--service_ensure)

##### <a name="-k3s--mode"></a>`mode`

Data type: `Enum['server', 'agent']`

Controls whether the node is configured as a `server` or an `agent`.

Default value: `'server'`

##### <a name="-k3s--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

Whether k3s should be installed (`present`) or uninstalled (`absent`).

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-k3s--channel"></a>`channel`

Data type: `String[1]`

Upstream k3s release channel, for example `stable`, `latest`, or `testing`.

Default value: `'stable'`

##### <a name="-k3s--version"></a>`version`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Optional pinned k3s version such as `v1.30.4+k3s1`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-k3s--manage_prerequisites"></a>`manage_prerequisites`

Data type: `Boolean`

When true, install the prerequisite operating system packages before
downloading k3s.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-k3s--packages"></a>`packages`

Data type: `Variant[Array[String[1]], Hash[String[1], Array[String[1]]]]`

Either a flat array of package names or an OS-family keyed hash of package
lists.

Default value:

```puppet
{
    'Debian' => ['curl', 'ca-certificates'],
    'RedHat' => ['curl', 'ca-certificates'],
  }
```

##### <a name="-k3s--config_dir"></a>`config_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Directory that contains the managed k3s configuration.

Default value: `'/etc/rancher/k3s'`

##### <a name="-k3s--config_file"></a>`config_file`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Full path to the managed `config.yaml` file.

Default value: `'/etc/rancher/k3s/config.yaml'`

##### <a name="-k3s--token"></a>`token`

Data type: `Optional[Sensitive[String[1]]]`

Optional cluster token as `Sensitive[String]`. Store this in encrypted Hiera
or another secret backend.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-k3s--server"></a>`server`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

API endpoint of an existing k3s server. Required for agents and for
additional server nodes that join an existing cluster.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-k3s--cluster_init"></a>`cluster_init`

Data type: `Boolean`

Enables `cluster-init` for the first control-plane node in an embedded etcd
topology.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-k3s--write_kubeconfig_mode"></a>`write_kubeconfig_mode`

Data type: `String[1]`

File mode used by k3s when writing the kubeconfig file on server nodes.

Default value: `'0640'`

##### <a name="-k3s--node_name"></a>`node_name`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Optional Kubernetes node name override.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-k3s--node_labels"></a>`node_labels`

Data type: `Array[String[1]]`

Array of Kubernetes node labels to pass into the k3s configuration.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-k3s--node_taints"></a>`node_taints`

Data type: `Array[String[1]]`

Array of Kubernetes node taints to pass into the k3s configuration.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-k3s--disable"></a>`disable`

Data type: `Array[String[1]]`

Array of bundled server components to disable, for example `['traefik']`.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-k3s--flannel_backend"></a>`flannel_backend`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Optional flannel backend selection for server nodes.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-k3s--selinux"></a>`selinux`

Data type: `Boolean`

Enables `selinux: true` in the k3s config for SELinux-capable platforms.

Default value: `$facts['os']['family'] == 'RedHat'`

##### <a name="-k3s--service_enable"></a>`service_enable`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether the resulting systemd service should be enabled at boot.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-k3s--service_ensure"></a>`service_ensure`

Data type: `Enum['running', 'stopped']`

Desired service state for the node.

Default value: `'running'`

##### <a name="-k3s--install--mode"></a>`mode`

Data type: `String[1]`

Upstream k3s release channel.

##### <a name="-k3s--install--version"></a>`version`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Optional pinned k3s version.

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether prerequisite packages should be installed.
